propositions: Effective review criteria and routing are currently read through multiple seams, allowing project disables to be ignored and project DET criteria to disappear between separate reads.

A single immutable CriteriaSnapshot authority must be compiled once per repository and operation, containing effective built-ins, project LLM criteria, project DET criteria, and a deterministic digest, before any gate selection or model call.

Code-review project LLM criteria must validate applies_to as a non-empty list of repository-relative globs or the special literal ["**"] for repository-wide unconditional selection, rejecting empty or missing applies_to before any gate executes.

The applies_to: ["**"] spelling for code-review project criteria must select unconditionally even when changed_files is empty, preserving the prior behavior of applies_to: [] as an ungated short-circuit.

The stricter non-empty-glob rule applies only to code-review project LLM criteria at snapshot-compile time, not to the shared _validate_applies_to validator, leaving plan-review and other gates unaffected.

Contract tests must prove snapshot-derived selection matches current behavior for non-overlay cases and approved corrections for disables/retunes/DET inclusion, with explicit coverage of the empty-changed-files diverging edge.
